rationale: The stock gapped down ~3.55% on 7.5x relative volume and has been extremely volatile in the last two candles (a 135-point range candle followed by another wide swing), suggesting a news-driven dislocation with no clear directional resolution yet. The bid-ask spread of 104 bps is prohibitively wide for intraday scalping, and the 9-EMA ($36.70) sits well above the current price ($36.40) while price is mid-range (41%), offering no clean technical edge in either direction. Waiting for price to stabilize and spread to compress before committing capital is the prudent course.
